title: Asymptotic majority Fourier tail bound
statement: For each natural number $j$, set $a_j=0$ if $j$ is even and $a_j=\frac{2}{j2^j}\binom{j-1}{(j-1)/2}$ if $j$ is odd. For every odd natural number $k$, define $W_k=\frac{2}{\pi}\sum_{j>k}a_j$ and $T_k=(2/\pi)^{3/2}k^{-1/2}$. Then $\left|W_k/T_k-1\right|\leq 1/k$.
